A.claim: Beal is FALSE over the Gaussian integers: (-2+i)^3 + (-2-i)^3 = (1+i)^4, with exponents (3,3,4) all >= 3 and bases sharing no Gaussian prime (norms 5, 5, 2). Therefore Beal cannot be proved from unique factorisation alone; any valid proof must use the total ordering of Z or the ramification of rational primes.

B.claim: The linear form z log C - y log B from the size window equals log(1 + A^x/B^y) identically, so it carries no information beyond the ratio of the summands and yields no new obstruction. Combining the M3 size window with the M1 congruence sieve gives a ~17x search reduction.
